chain.title: Compress the first flux
chain.desc: Leave one air block between bedrock below and obsidian above. Drop redstone dust into the gap, then left-click the obsidian to compress it into Flux Dust. Check pack changes if this recipe is replaced.

chain.title: A core for wireless power
chain.desc: Craft Flux Cores for the network connectors. Gather enough for both the sending Plug and receiving Point so the first network can perform a complete transfer.

chain.title: Prepare storage components
chain.desc: Craft a Flux Block for storage and controller recipes. A basic Plug-to-Point network can work before these optional upgrades.

chain.title: Configure connections consistently
chain.desc: Use a Flux Configurator to manage compatible network blocks. Keep network ownership, priorities, and limits intentional as you expand to more machines.

chain.title: Send energy into the network
chain.desc: Attach a Flux Plug to a power source that permits output. Create or select your network in its interface.

chain.title: Receive energy at a machine
chain.desc: Attach a Flux Point to a consumer and select the same network as the Plug. Test one transfer before adding other consumers.

chain.title: A network buffer
chain.desc: Add Basic Flux Storage to the intended network. Storage smooths demand, but generation must still cover sustained use.

chain.title: Manage portable charging
chain.desc: Configure a Flux Controller for wireless item charging and network control. Choose the intended equipment slots and keep network access permissions appropriate.

chain.title: Expand the shared reserve
chain.desc: Upgrade storage capacity when the network needs a larger reserve. Monitor demand and generation before spending resources on more buffering.

chain.title: A reserve for major projects
chain.desc: Build the larger storage tier for demanding jobs. Check priorities and transfer limits so the extra reserve reaches the machines that need it.

Pack scripts, recipe changes, and other Minecraft versions require the installed-pack scan; this guide is not a complete mod manual.
